customer_id.description: The customer who paid; left out, the first invoice's customer. Every invoice is the customer's.

date.description: The day the money came into the account.

fx_rate.description: For invoices in another currency received into an account in that currency: base currency per one unit, as on the bank's advice. Left out, the cascade's rate for the date (ENG-40).

invoices.description: What it settles of each invoice.

money_account_id.description: The bank, card or wallet account it came into: an active money account in the invoices' currency or in the base currency.

examples: Paid by FAST from the customer's DBS account

received.description: For invoices in another currency received into a base-currency account: what the account received, in the base currency, as the statement shows it; the receipt settles at the rate it implies. Required then, and only then (LEDGER-27).

unapplied.description: What it received beyond the invoices, in their currency: kept as a credit with the customer (FR-AR-18). Left out, nothing.
